parameters.content: ### A · TRIGGER & MARKET DATA\nRuns every 6h. Pulls CoinGecko prices, computes gold-units/direction per coin, and decides Golden Season / Dark Siege / Waiting Plains. Flat markets stop the run here — matches run_pipeline.php Steps 1–2.

### B/C · CLAN SELECT & CONTEXT\nPicks which clan runs (a >12% mover forces its clan; otherwise rotation). Then reads character/heaven state (MySQL), memory + creator override (Airtable), and the live style guide + all 3 prompts straight from your GitHub repo's raw URLs. Edit the docs in GitHub and every future run picks up the change automatically.

### D · GENERATE + REVIEW\nClaude writes the episode, a second Claude call reviews it against review_agent.md's checklist. One retry with the review feedback injected, exactly like run_pipeline.php Step 8. Fails twice -> logged and the run stops quietly (no bad episode goes out).

### E · MILESTONES & CELEBRATION\nChecks every coin in this clan's Gate/Heaven thresholds against what's already recorded. Any new crossing swaps in a full celebration_episode.md-style episode instead of the standard one.

### F · SAVE + STATE\nInserts the story, asks Claude for a 2-sentence memory summary, writes it to Airtable, then runs one consolidated SQL batch for prices/heavens/settings/rotation log (mirrors updateCharacterPrices/updateHeavenPositions/updateSetting/logClanRotation).

### G/H · VOICE + VIDEO (Phase 2)
ElevenLabs narrates the full script as Aragorn. ffmpeg overlays the live price data onto a pre-made clan/mood background (your 'reusable library' choice) and muxes in the narration.

⚠️ Needs: (1) real backgrounds placed at /data/coinor/backgrounds/, (2) ffmpeg installed in your n8n host/container — NOT present by default.

### I · PUBLISH (fully automatic)\nUploads straight to YouTube (core YouTube node) and TikTok (placeholder — see that node's note on the real multi-step upload + required app approval) with no manual review step, as you chose.

### BEFORE YOU IMPORT
1. Create credentials named to match: Anthropic API Key, ElevenLabs API Key, Hostinger MySQL, Airtable, YouTube OAuth2, TikTok header auth — n8n will ask you to map each on import.
2. Fill in: Airtable base ID (2 nodes), ARAGORN_VOICE_ID, donation wallet addresses, background image folder, ffmpeg availability.
3. Run database_setup.sql on your MySQL instance if you haven't already.
4. Create an 'Error Workflow' in n8n settings pointing at a small logger workflow so silent failures (not just the review-fail path) get recorded too.
